items.title: How many leaf nodes a fully-branching tree has, as depth grows
items.description: This grounds L2's claim that hand-tracing becomes unmanageable as depth or branching grows: for a tree where every folder has the same number of children (the branching factor) down to a fixed depth, the number of leaf nodes is branchingFactor raised to the depth — a real exponential, not an exaggeration. Even modest branching and depth produce more leaves than anyone could realistically trace by hand.
items.compute: const leafCount = Math.pow(params.branchingFactor, params.depth); return { leafCount };
